gallery.title: 经典的回响
gallery.subtitle: 公共领域艺术数字展
gallery.preface: 本展汇集已进入公共领域的艺术杰作：从维米尔的静谧窗光到葛饰北斋的巨浪，从梵高的麦田到修拉的点彩河岸。这些作品的原作分藏于大都会艺术博物馆等机构，其高清图像已以公共领域或 CC0 方式向全世界开放。我们希望用一座可以随时走进的浏览器展厅，让经典在数字空间中再次被看见、被走近、被凝视。请自由行走，靠近任何一件作品，灯光会为你亮起。

zones.name: 东翼 · 雕塑与器物厅

exhibits.title: 米洛的维纳斯
exhibits.medium: 大理石（3D 扫描自石膏铸件）
exhibits.credit: 3D 扫描：SMK – 丹麦国家美术馆（CC0 / Public Domain）；原作藏巴黎卢浮宫
exhibits.description: 1820 年发现于希腊米洛岛，是希腊化时期最著名的大理石雕像之一。女神从容的站姿与失佚的双臂，反而成就了后世对古典美的无尽想象。本展台的模型来自丹麦国家美术馆 Royal Cast Collection 的石膏铸件扫描（编号 KAS434/1），以 CC0 公共领域方式开放。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Discovered on the island of Melos in 1820, this is one of the most celebrated marble statues of the Hellenistic age. The goddess's poised stance and the mystery of her missing arms have fueled centuries of imagination about classical beauty. This model is scanned from the Royal Cast Collection at the National Gallery of Denmark (No. KAS434/1), released under CC0 / Public Domain; the original is in the Louvre, Paris.

exhibits.title: 华盛顿横渡特拉华河
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 描绘 1776 年圣诞夜华盛顿率大陆军夜渡冰封的特拉华河、奇袭特伦顿的历史时刻。洛伊茨以浪漫主义手法将冰河、晨光与星条旗组织成极具戏剧张力的构图，成为美国历史画的标志。此画尺幅巨大（原作逾 3.7×6.4 米），悬挂于大都会美国翼的显要墙面。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Leutze depicts the historic Christmas-night crossing of the icy Delaware River in 1776, when Washington led the Continental Army in a surprise attack on Trenton. Composing ice, dawn light and the Stars and Stripes into a scene of high drama, he created an icon of American history painting. The original is monumental (over 3.7 × 6.4 m) and hangs in a prominent position in the Met's American Wing.

exhibits.title: 麦田与柏树
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 1889 年梵高在圣雷米疗养院期间创作了多幅柏树主题作品。旋涡状的天空、火焰般的柏树与金黄麦浪，是他晚期最具辨识度的视觉语言。梵高曾写信给弟弟提奥，称柏树“像埃及方尖碑一样美”，是他最满意的母题之一。
exhibits.descriptionEn: During his stay at Saint-Rémy in 1889, Van Gogh painted several works on the cypress motif. The whirling sky, flame-like cypresses and golden wheat became some of the most recognizable visual language of his late period. In a letter to his brother Theo he wrote that cypresses were 'as beautiful as an Egyptian obelisk' — one of his favorite subjects.

exhibits.title: 前言
exhibits.credit: LUMEN 流明 · 虚拟美术馆模板
exhibits.description: 本展汇集已进入公共领域的艺术杰作：从维米尔的静谧窗光到葛饰北斋的巨浪，从梵高的麦田到修拉的点彩河岸。这些作品的高清图像已以公共领域方式向全世界开放。请自由行走，靠近任何一件作品，灯光会为你亮起。
exhibits.descriptionEn: This exhibition brings together masterpieces that have entered the public domain: from Vermeer's quiet window light to Hokusai's great wave, from Van Gogh's wheat fields to Seurat's pointillist riverbank. High-resolution images of these works are open to the world under public-domain terms. Walk freely; approach any work and the light will find you.

exhibits.title: 戴草帽的自画像
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 1887 年梵高旅居巴黎期间创作了一系列自画像——既因请不起模特，也为试验点彩派与印象派的新色彩。蓝绿色背景上，厚涂的笔触层层堆叠，草帽的明黄与面部的暖调形成强烈对比。此画背面还藏着另一幅作品《削土豆的人》。
exhibits.descriptionEn: During his stay in Paris in 1887, Van Gogh painted a series of self-portraits — partly because he could not afford models, and partly to experiment with the new colors of Pointillism and Impressionism. Against a blue-green ground, thickly applied brushstrokes build up in layers, and the yellow of the straw hat contrasts sharply with the warm tones of the face. On the reverse of this panel lies another painting, The Potato Peeler.

exhibits.title: 持水壶的年轻女子
exhibits.titleEn: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 维米尔成熟期的代表作之一：晨光从左侧窗户漫入，女子一手扶窗、一手持银水壶，神情安宁。画家以极细腻的色层表现织物、金属与地图的质感，被称为“代尔夫特的珍珠”。维米尔存世作品仅三十余幅，每一件都弥足珍贵。
exhibits.descriptionEn: One of Vermeer's mature masterpieces: morning light floods in from a window on the left as a woman rests one hand on the casement and holds a silver pitcher in the other. With extraordinarily fine layers of pigment, Vermeer renders fabric, metal and a map with almost tactile precision — earning him the nickname 'the Pearl of Delft'. Fewer than forty paintings by Vermeer survive, each one precious.

exhibits.title: 蓬图瓦兹的雅莱山丘
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 毕沙罗是印象派画家中唯一参加了全部八次印象派展览的人，被塞尚、高更尊为师长。这幅 1867 年的蓬图瓦兹风景以稳健的水平结构组织田野、屋顶与山坡，色调朴素而开阔，是理解印象派前夕风景画转型的关键作品。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Pissarro was the only Impressionist to participate in all eight Impressionist exhibitions, and was regarded as a mentor by Cézanne and Gauguin. This 1867 view of Pontoise organizes fields, rooftops and hillside into a stable horizontal structure, with a sober, expansive palette — a key work for understanding the turn toward Impressionism.

exhibits.title: 粉色连衣裙
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 莫里索是印象派团体中最重要的女性画家，擅长以轻盈的笔触捕捉日常人物的神态。画中人身着粉色长裙安坐，背景的笔触松弛灵动，展现了她介于肖像与风俗画之间的独特气质。1874 年她参加了首届印象派展览，是该团体中唯一的女性创始成员之一。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Morisot was the leading woman painter of the Impressionist group, known for capturing the mood of everyday figures with light, agile brushwork. Here a woman sits in a pink dress while the background dissolves into loose, animated strokes — a style poised between portrait and genre painting. In 1874 she took part in the first Impressionist exhibition, one of its only female founding members.

exhibits.title: 《大碗岛的星期天下午》习作
exhibits.titleEn: Study for “A Sunday on La Grande Jatte”
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 这是修拉为芝加哥艺术博物馆镇馆巨作《大碗岛的星期天下午》所作的数十幅习作之一。1884–86 年间，修拉以“点彩法”把光谱般的色点组织成宁静的河畔人群，开创了新印象主义。习作尺幅虽小，却已能看到最终构图的河湾与光影骨架。
exhibits.descriptionEn: This is one of dozens of studies Seurat made for his monumental A Sunday on La Grande Jatte, now at the Art Institute of Chicago. Between 1884 and 1886, Seurat used 'Pointillism' to arrange spectral dots of color into a serene riverside crowd, inaugurating Neo-Impressionism. Though small, the study already reveals the bay and the play of light that anchor the final composition.

exhibits.title: 舞蹈课
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 德加毕生着迷于芭蕾舞者：排练厅的镜面、把杆、斜切构图与瞬间姿态，都是他从摄影与日本版画中借来的现代眼光。这幅 1874 年的《舞蹈课》是首届印象派展览的参展作品，画面中央的老教师是当时的芭蕾大师朱尔·佩罗。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Degas was fascinated by ballet dancers throughout his life: the mirrors of the rehearsal room, the barre, the diagonal compositions and fleeting poses all reflect a modern eye borrowed from photography and Japanese prints. This 1874 Dance Class was shown at the first Impressionist exhibition; the elderly teacher at center is the ballet master Jules Perrot.

exhibits.title: 神奈川冲浪里
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 《富岳三十六景》中最负盛名的一帧：巨浪如爪，远处富士山岿然不动。北斋大胆使用进口普鲁士蓝，使浪花的层次前所未有地鲜明。此作对欧洲印象派与后印象派影响深远，德彪西《大海》的封面即取材于此浪。
exhibits.descriptionEn: The most celebrated print of Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji: a great wave coils like a claw while Mount Fuji stands motionless in the distance. Hokusai's bold use of imported Prussian blue gives the spray an unprecedented clarity. The work profoundly influenced European Impressionism and Post-Impressionism — Debussy's La Mer famously took this wave for its cover.

exhibits.title: 大卫 · 头像
exhibits.medium: 大理石胸像（1899 年铸件 3D 扫描）
exhibits.credit: 3D 扫描：Thomas Flynn，源自 SMK Royal Cast Collection（CC-BY 4.0）；原作藏佛罗伦萨学院美术馆
exhibits.description: 米开朗基罗以一整块被弃用的巨型大理石雕成《大卫》，成为佛罗伦萨共和国的精神象征。紧锁的眉宇与侧视的目光，凝聚了战斗前一刻的意志。本展台为 1899 年裁切胸像铸件的高精度扫描，源自丹麦国家美术馆馆藏。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Michelangelo carved David from a single, previously abandoned block of marble, and the statue became a symbol of the Florentine Republic. The knitted brow and sidelong gaze concentrate the will of the moment before battle. This display is a high-resolution scan of an 1899 bust cast, from the National Gallery of Denmark.

exhibits.title: 思想者
exhibits.medium: 青铜（3D 摄影测量扫描）
exhibits.credit: 3D 扫描：Rigsters（CC-BY 4.0）；原作藏巴黎罗丹博物馆
exhibits.description: 《思想者》最初是罗丹为巴黎装饰艺术博物馆大门《地狱之门》设计的顶部人物，原意为俯瞰人类命运的但丁。全身紧绷的肌肉与低垂的目光，把“沉思”变成了可触的形体。本展台为 2017 年实地摄影测量扫描（约 700 张照片重建），按 CC-BY 4.0 共享，须署名 Rigsters。
exhibits.descriptionEn: The Thinker was originally conceived as the crowning figure of Rodin's Gates of Hell for the Musée des Arts Décoratifs in Paris, intended as Dante gazing down upon human destiny. The tensed muscles and lowered gaze turn 'thought' into tangible form. This model is a 2017 photogrammetric scan (reconstructed from roughly 700 photographs), shared under CC-BY 4.0 with attribution to Rigsters.

exhibits.title: 掷铁饼者
exhibits.medium: 大理石摹制品（3D 扫描自石膏铸件）
exhibits.credit: 3D 扫描：SMK – 丹麦国家美术馆（CC0 / Public Domain）；青铜原作已佚
exhibits.description: 古希腊雕塑家米隆的《掷铁饼者》凝固了运动员回旋发力的瞬间，被奉为古典时期“运动中的平衡”的典范。原作已佚，今仅存数件罗马时代大理石摹品。本展台为丹麦国家美术馆 Royal Cast Collection 的石膏铸件扫描，以 CC0 公共领域方式开放。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Myron's Discobolus freezes the moment an athlete coils to release the discus — celebrated as the classical ideal of 'balance in motion'. The bronze original is lost; only a few Roman marble copies survive. This display is scanned from the Royal Cast Collection at the National Gallery of Denmark, released under CC0 / Public Domain.

exhibits.title: 青花釉里红龙纹梅瓶
exhibits.titleEn: Meiping Vase with Dragons amid Waves
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 梅瓶因小口仅容梅枝而得名，自宋代以来即是经典瓶式。此瓶以青花与釉里红同绘海水龙纹——釉里红烧成极难，红蓝相映者尤为名贵。展柜内为藏品照片立牌，实物藏于大都会亚洲艺术部。
exhibits.descriptionEn: The meiping — literally 'prunus vase' — is named for its narrow mouth, just wide enough for a plum branch, and has been a classic form since the Song dynasty. This vase paints dragons amid waves in underglaze cobalt blue and copper red; copper red is notoriously difficult to fire, making the red-and-blue pairing especially prized. The case shows a photograph of the object, held in the Met's Asian Art department.

exhibits.title: 黑绘/红绘双耳陶瓶
exhibits.credit: 大都会艺术博物馆 · 公共领域
exhibits.description: 这件阿提卡双耳瓶出自黑绘向红绘过渡的关键时期，相传与“红绘法发明者”安多基德斯画师有关。瓶身两侧以两种技法描绘相似场景，犹如一场新旧风格的并排实验，是陶瓷史上的教科书级名作。
exhibits.descriptionEn: This Attic amphora dates from the pivotal transition from black-figure to red-figure, and is associated with the Andokides Painter, credited with inventing red-figure. The two sides render similar scenes in the two techniques — a side-by-side experiment between old and new styles, and a textbook masterpiece in the history of ceramics.

exhibits.title: 《Sintel》预告片
exhibits.description: 《Sintel》是 Blender 基金会第三部开源电影，讲述少女 Sintel 寻找幼年救下的小龙的旅程。全片使用开源软件 Blender 制作，所有素材以 CC-BY 协议开放。场景内静音循环，打开详情可开声完整观看。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Sintel is the Blender Foundation's third open movie, telling the story of a young woman's quest to find the baby dragon she rescued. The film was made entirely with the open-source software Blender, and all assets are released under Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY). In the gallery it loops silently; open the details to watch with sound.

exhibits.title: 关于公共领域
exhibits.credit: LUMEN 流明 · 虚拟美术馆模板
exhibits.description: 当作品的版权保护期届满，它便进入公共领域，成为全人类可以自由使用、改编与再创造的文化遗产。大都会艺术博物馆 2017 年起以 CC0 开放逾 37 万件藏品图像；芝加哥艺术博物馆、荷兰国立博物馆等亦相继跟进。本展厅的全部演示素材即来自这些开放馆藏——换一批素材，就是一座新馆。
exhibits.descriptionEn: When a work's copyright term expires, it enters the public domain — cultural heritage that everyone may freely use, adapt and re-create. Since 2017, The Metropolitan Museum of Art has released more than 370,000 collection images under CC0; the Art Institute of Chicago and the Rijksmuseum have followed suit. All this gallery's demo assets come from these open collections — swap in another set, and it becomes a new museum.

exhibits.title: 大都会开放获取
exhibits.description: 大都会艺术博物馆的 Open Access 计划将逾 37 万件公共领域藏品的高清图像与元数据以 CC0 协议开放，无需申请即可用于任何用途。本展的大部分绘画与器物照片即来自该计划。点击“前往访问”探索全部开放馆藏。
exhibits.descriptionEn: The Met's Open Access program releases high-resolution images and metadata for more than 370,000 public-domain works under CC0, free to use for any purpose without application. Most of this exhibition's paintings and objects come from the program. Tap 'Visit' to explore the full open collection.
